Welcome to the Divoom API

    
##### command description

- Command to send current temperature and weather


| Head  |Len   | Cmd   |Data|Checksum   |Tail   |
| :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: |
|0x01   |xx (2 bytes) |0x5F |data[]| xx |0x02   |

Data:
Data[0]: Temperature value, can be negative (char type).

Data[1]: Weather type.
